findings: Scores and recommendation accepted, but fidelity_reason says 'real server process' while the test uses Live::thread (in-process server thread) and asserts the real tempdir socket parent mode 0700 then graceful stop (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:689-697). The filesystem boundary is real, so F=4 stands; only the fidelity_reason text is corrected.

final_review.behavior: A thread-hosted real server creates its socket parent directory with mode 0700, observed directly from the filesystem, then stops gracefully.
final_review.failure_caught: Startup could create or leave the socket directory accessible to other local users, letting them connect to or replace the control socket.
final_review.criticality_reason: Socket-directory permissions gate other local accounts access to the control channel, a privacy/authority boundary (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/startup.rs:490-540).
final_review.signal_reason: One exact mode assertion on the real directory; decisive for the property but blind to socket-file mode (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:689-697).
final_review.uniqueness_reason: Distinct from the shared-directory test, which asserts the directory is not modified; this asserts creation mode (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:689-698).
final_review.fidelity_reason: Thread-hosted real server code (Live::thread) creates the socket parent in a real tempdir; the asserted boundary is the filesystem mode and graceful stop, so no child process is required (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:689-697).
final_review.recommendation_reason: Decisive security assertion on a real OS boundary with no equivalent retained coverage.
cost_drivers: real server start on a thread

findings: Sequenced Busy(1) is accepted; receipt-mode, replayed sequence 1 and sequence 0 are Conflict with activity unchanged, sequence 2 Idle is accepted, and post-kill reports are Conflict (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:710-790). S4/U3 supported.

Two real hook children; the wrong-session token is Conflict while both activities stay Unknown (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:812-830), paused reports are accepted with phase still Paused (870-895), and closed/killed reports are NotFound/Conflict (900-925). C4/S4/U3/F4 and keep are supported.

A startup report makes Busy visible before HOOK_READY, then kill retains the terminal text and removes the group (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:931-948). It does not assert publication revision/order, supporting S3/U2 rather than S4.

Real filesystem symlink and real run_server error: the message must contain both 'server socket directory' and 'symlink' and no socket may exist (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:1604-1612). The compound negative assertion fully covers the claimed refusal, so S4 is defensible.

Two real connect_or_start callers both obtain streams, one Shutdown is answered Ok and the socket disappears (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:1645-1680); process count is not asserted, which the row itself states, so S3/U3/F4 and keep are correct.

Two real server children are spawned over a stale socket; exactly one exits and the survivor answers Shutdown before the socket disappears (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:1945-1968,2018-2024). The loser's reason is not asserted, matching S3/U2.

Live shell blocks removal for both force values (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:2455-2470); after the shell dies non-force still refuses, force removes the dirty worktree, keeps the branch and clears the filed row's acknowledgment (2478-2508). C4/S4/F4 supported.

A fast-exiting shell is observed Exited, acknowledged, removed, and the remaining shell/workspace teardown succeeds (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:2679-2720); retained text is not asserted, matching S3/U2.

After detach/exit the live screen contains FINAL_HISTORY_MARKER but not the evicted offscreen line, HistoryBegin/pages contain both retained marker and DETACHED_OFFSCREEN_000, and the first page respects PAGE_BYTES (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:4800-4880). S4/U3/F4 supported.

Fifty real managed sessions are selected and re-selected through two dashboards, all 50 marker screens are observed, 50 pgids exist and none survives kill (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:5660-5755). This is the direct 50-session invariant; C4/S4/U4/F4 supported.

Real CLI spawns a separate real server, creates a detached session with DETACHED_READY, then shutdown --kill exits the server, removes the socket and leaves no recorded group (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:7300-7355). F4/C4 supported.

The shared admission helper sends a branch SessionEnd and asserts binding and activity_revision stay at the bound values while health becomes Unavailable, with later callbacks not rebinding (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:9810-9827). S4/U2 accepted; the 3-line body delegates to the fully read helper.

The helper asserts exact native argv including --resume and the conversation UUID (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:9455-9468), refuses wrong/child/missing-source callbacks, binds the matching resume root, then observes conversation usage 10/1 and 60/6 once (9500-9560). S4/U3/F4 supported.

Consolidate rejected. The row calls the shared resume helper with -r/2.1.274 (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:9956-9958). Production has no version gate and the version is diagnostic only (src/report/admission.rs:21,206-221), so the path is identical to the 2.1.268 row; however the retained not-gated row covers 2.1.266 and an unparsable version, not an above-floor release, so a future upper-bound regression could escape the retained pair. This is a cheap distinct input boundary, not complete subsumption: U=2 and keep.

final_review.behavior: The same resume flow with `-r` on Claude 2.1.274: argv, binding, usage collection and branch/clear transitions behave identically to the 2.1.268 case.
final_review.failure_caught: A patch version bump could silently change resume eligibility or argv handling, resuming wrongly or as a fresh session.
final_review.criticality_reason: Resume regressions break conversation continuity, a major workflow failure; this row only varies the version string (src/report/admission.rs:88-190).
final_review.signal_reason: The helper asserts argv, binding, usage and lifecycle thoroughly, but those assertions duplicate the 2.1.268 short-resume row (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:9450-9540).
final_review.uniqueness_reason: The 2.1.274 release is a distinct above-floor patch input; the helper and assertions match the 2.1.268 row, but the retained not-gated row covers only 2.1.266 and an unparsable version, so this input is not fully subsumed (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:9956-9958; src/report/admission.rs:21,206-221).
final_review.fidelity_reason: Real native fixture and real resume callbacks (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:9370-9410).
final_review.recommendation_reason: Keep as a cheap version-boundary probe: the only difference is the diagnostic version constant, but it is a distinct input not covered by the 2.1.268 or not-gated rows.

findings: The helper drives a 25-case activity table, asserting per case the exact activity_revision, state, turn and input_requests, including stale prior-turn Stop/Notification leaving no Input and Stop closing approval (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:10053-10300). S4/U4/F4 supported.

Outer test spawns its own ignored helper subprocess with a foreign OVRCR_AGENT_SOCKET/TOKEN (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:10313-10330); the helper proves the fresh PTY sees neither variable and its own report becomes Busy (10348-10362). Real process/PTY boundary; C4/S4/U4/F4 supported.

A real ticket first navigates; while two WIP shutdown questions are queued the same click is ignored, with unchanged rows/session/git refs/checkout bytes and no WIP refs, then explicit Escapes answer each (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:12870-13030). C4/S4/U4/F4 supported.
Four overlay cases each assert the draft token is gone, rows/unread/manual_title are unchanged, and a reopened palette is empty (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:13170-13240). S4/U3 supported.
Five malformed tickets each fail with empty stdout and no server socket (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:13465-13515). This is decisive negative coverage of the CLI ticket boundary; S4/U3 supported.

A historical Stop invents no binding/Unread, resume attach is Unknown with no alert, the new turn becomes Observed Ready with one alert, and a duplicate Stop adds none (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:13635-13715). S4/U3 supported.
Archiving drops Unread; after a real restart the row keeps Agent kind, shows unavailable recovery and is non-live with no Unread (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:14835-14897). S3/U3 accepted.

Request ids/kinds, underlying Busy/Ready samples, alert-title vectors, reattach baseline and cleared-requests-with-Unread on reporter loss are all asserted (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:15000-15180). S4/U3 supported.
Reattach becomes generation 2 with Unknown activity while the first Unread survives, and the next cycle produces a new Unread in generation 2 (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:15600-15655). S4/U3 supported.

The first host is blocked, a second completion queues, visibility churn does not release it, and after the blocker is killed exactly one delivery is recorded (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:17995-18035). C2/S3/U3 supported.

The real 30s polling budget expires, the screen shows unconfirmed plus the check action, polling stops for 1.2s, controls are status/authorize/status-only and bounded, and no delivery occurs (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:18465-18540). C2/S3 accepted; this is the slow30 row at 35.784s.

The title worker receives PROMPT_SECRET/RESPONSE_SECRET/ANSWER_SECRET and generates GENERATED_SUBJECT_SECRET, while every recorded desktop-host request contains none of them and uses the generic subtitle/body (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:18900-18980). Real server/host boundary; C4/S4/U4/F4 supported.

For both sound and choice changes the started client ends in <1s, the persistent host survives, no banner is admitted, the next completion uses the new preference, and the saved document matches (tests/server_lifecycle.rs:19485-19550). C2/S4/U3/F4 supported.

The fixture asserts exactly 50 live sessions, opens Agents, moves 45 rows to navigation-45, attaches and proves a payload reached that agent (tests/terminal_acceptance.rs:1485-1510). C4/S3/U4/F4 supported.

Remote default is origin/trunk; after the shortcut the workspace is feature/wizard, selected in Browse, has exactly one Terminal session named local, and its HEAD equals origin/trunk with a working shell (tests/terminal_acceptance.rs:1520-1660). C3/S4/U3/F4 supported.

Pause shows Paused and List phase Paused, detach/reattach preserves it, r clears Paused and Enter+token yields PAUSE_RESUME_ACK (tests/terminal_acceptance.rs:2800-2860; shell ACK at tests/terminal_acceptance.rs:128). C3/S4/U3/F4 supported.

The shared helper parses the dashboard's requested keyboard flags, sends the shifted '/', and waits for the Which-key overlay in a real dashboard PTY (tests/terminal_acceptance/keyboard_protocol.rs:6-20,49-51). C2/S3/U2/F4 supported; the 3-line body delegates to the fully read helper.

TMUX-wrapped iTerm metadata must not jump: a later shifted packet opens the palette, with no 'Session selected' and no jump labels (tests/terminal_acceptance/keyboard_protocol.rs:180-196). C3/S4/U3/F4 supported.
